note: TestRFC1350DuplicateACKTriggersNoDATA: after ACK 1 and DATA 2, a second ACK 1 must produce no datagram for 1 s (the ACK timeout is 5 s, so a timeout retransmission cannot confound it); judge re-ran it against HEAD's handler.go by overlay and it fails 'DATA sent in answer to a duplicate ACK: got opcode 3 block 2', so it discriminates the Sorcerer's Apprentice bug. Positive: a fresh ACK 2 is answered by DATA 3, and after ACK 3 silence, so block 3 is sent once. Producer sendAndWaitACK now keeps reading to the same deadline on a non-matching packet (isACKFor).
